final: WITH m AS (SELECT p.death_country AS c, v.points_won * 1.0 / v.points_max AS r FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id), g AS (SELECT c, AVG(r) AS avg_r FROM m WHERE r IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_r) AS overall FROM g WHERE avg_r IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.c AS death_country, g.avg_r AS avg_ratio, g.avg_r / o.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall IS NOT NULL ORDER BY g.c
